vetSays.line: ★ IDENTIFIED: Elderberry. White flower clusters in spring, dark berries in late summer. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.

Lauren was watching. Now they know Elderberry too.

You watch closely — Elderberry is yours now too.

The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village.
